Daily responsibilities include drafting and reviewing documents, handling incoming and outgoing communications, and ensuring accurate documentation of company secretarial work such as minutes, reports, and official filings. The role involves liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders, arranging travel and logistics, and supporting the smooth execution of executive decisions and company initiatives. The Executive Secretary will also assist with customer and partner inquiries, maintain confidentiality of sensitive information, and help improve office processes for greater efficiency. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong clerical skills, including document preparation, data entry, filing, and records management. Candidates should possess excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with internal and external stakeholders. Candidates should possess experience in company secretarial work, such as preparing minutes, reports, and official documentation in line with organizational standards. Candidates should possess executive administrative assistance skills, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and follow-up on action items. Candidates should possess solid customer service skills, demonstrating responsiveness, professionalism, and problem-solving when dealing with clients and partners. Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field are preferred. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and familiarity with digital document and scheduling tools is beneficial. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, discretion with confidential information, and the ability to work independently and under time pressure are important for success in this role.
